--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Upto
/-- The "greater than" relation on `Upto p` is well founded if (and only if) there exists a value
satisfying `p`. -/
protected theorem wf : (∃ x, p x) → WellFounded (Upto.GT p)
  | ⟨x, h⟩ => by
    suffices Upto.GT p = InvImage (· < ·) fun y : Nat.Upto p => x - y.val by
      rw [this]
      exact (measure _).wf
    ext ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, _⟩
    dsimp [InvImage, Upto.GT]
    rw [tsub_lt_tsub_iff_left_of_le (le_of_not_lt fun h' => ha _ h' h)]

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Game.Birthday
@[simp]
theorem birthday_eq_zero {x : PGame} :
    birthday x = 0 ↔ IsEmpty x.LeftMoves ∧ IsEmpty x.RightMoves := by
  rw [birthday_def, max_eq_zero, lsub_eq_zero_iff, lsub_eq_zero_iff]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Real.Archimedean
theorem not_bddBelow_coe : ¬ (BddBelow <| range (fun (x : ℚ) ↦ (x : ℝ))) := by
  dsimp only [BddBelow, lowerBounds]
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]
  ext
  simpa using exists_rat_lt _

--src: Mathlib.Order.RelClasses
instance (f : α → ℕ) : IsWellFounded _ (InvImage (· < ·) f) :=
  ⟨(measure f).wf⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic
theorem Finite.exists_finset {s : Set α} (h : s.Finite) :
    ∃ s' : Finset α, ∀ a : α, a ∈ s' ↔ a ∈ s := by
  cases h.nonempty_fintype
  exact ⟨s.toFinset, fun _ => mem_toFinset⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.QPF.Univariate.Basic
theorem liftp_iff {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (x : F α) :
    Liftp p x ↔ ∃ a f, x = abs ⟨a, f⟩ ∧ ∀ i, p (f i) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    cases' h : repr y with a f
    use a, fun i => (f i).val
    constructor
    · rw [← hy, ← abs_repr y, h, ← abs_map]
      rfl
    intro i
    apply (f i).property
  rintro ⟨a, f, h₀, h₁⟩
  use abs ⟨a, fun i => ⟨f i, h₁ i⟩⟩
  rw [← abs_map, h₀]; rfl
